These four BSL modules are verbatim blobs from Vanessa Automation 1.2.043.42,
commit a0ce2ee9803dd69be52f682e5cf49e0938fd33f1. provenance.json records each
Git blob and raw SHA-256. The upstream BSD-3-Clause license is retained in the
paired third-party asset directory.

The regression applies the shipping cumulative r3 patch. It verifies that the
report branches and four/three-argument fallback survive the dynamic manager
resolution, that both system-form wrappers retain all callback and window
behavior, and that the closed platform namespace rejects unknown names before
dispatch. OneScript checks namespace argument handling; actual platform form
opening and strict Designer qualification are separate native acceptance.
